proposal:
Here is the canonicalized PostgreSQL SELECT statement:

```sql
SELECT AVG(patsim) AS mean_pattern_deviation_ratio
FROM advancedbehavior;
```

This query remains the same as it is already properly formatted and does not require any changes. It calculates the average value of the `patsim` column from the `advancedbehavior` table and aliases the result as `mean_pattern_deviation_ratio`.
